title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Sivagami invites Kanmani to a Homam for Rajasekar's recovery, but she refuses to attend. Hoping for their reunion, Sivagami urges Anbu to convince Kanmani to join the ritual.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Paraman fiercely confronts Sidharth for poisoning Ilamathi's food, but Kalamma intervenes. Later, Paraman consoles a distressed Ilamathi over the unfortunate incident.
